verdict.rationale: Asana provides a documented public REST API with authentication, task creation, webhooks, and app components (asana-docs-1,2,3,9,10), a discoverable docs site confirmed by probe (asana-probe-1), and an official MCP server for agentic access (asana-probe-3). No standard OpenAPI spec endpoint was found (asana-probe-2), slightly limiting machine-readability but not the core capability.
